population: One final observed season per player; all eligible teams; minimum 20 minutes and 10 team-season games.
outcome: Ever drafted, not draft in this season.
scaling: Original within-season performance standardization and peer winsorization retained when restricting years.
regions: Player-weighted peer quantiles in the full eligible cohort, before filtering own performance. Ties kept together.
inference: Exploratory after inspecting related plots. No correction for historical searches. No causal interpretation.

peak_tail_test.method: Single-step one-sided max-t college-cluster Rademacher multiplier bootstrap
peak_tail_test.contrast: First bin rate minus pooled rate in the next two bins; positive means decline
peak_tail_test.family: Every start bin 1 through 14, each versus its next two bins pooled by players
peak_tail_test.variance_correction: G/(G-1), where G counts colleges in the performance band; no further N/(N-p) correction
peak_tail_test.bootstrap: Centered linearized rate differences, common college signs across all comparisons, fixed original standard errors
peak_tail_test.interval: 95% simultaneous ONE-SIDED lower bounds; not two-sided confidence intervals; rounding/Monte Carlo may affect boundary decisions
peak_tail_test.scope: Adjusts location search within this fixed 14-comparison family only. Historical band/year/bin-count/tail-width searches are not covered.
peak_tail_test.assumptions: Approximate independence across colleges and adequate effective college/event counts. No own-performance or season adjustment.
peak_tail_test.warnings: Sparse events and few contributing colleges can impair the approximation. Diagnostic thresholds 30 and 10 are cautions, not validity guarantees.

independent_diagnostic.method: One-sided max-t independent-player Rademacher multiplier bootstrap
independent_diagnostic.contrast: First bin rate minus pooled rate in the next two bins; positive means decline
independent_diagnostic.family: Every start bin 1 through 14, each versus its next two bins pooled by players
independent_diagnostic.bootstrap: Centered linearized rate differences, common college signs across all comparisons, fixed original standard errors
independent_diagnostic.interval: 95% simultaneous ONE-SIDED lower bounds; not two-sided confidence intervals; rounding/Monte Carlo may affect boundary decisions
independent_diagnostic.scope: Adjusts location search within this fixed 14-comparison family only. Historical band/year/bin-count/tail-width searches are not covered.
independent_diagnostic.assumptions: Each final-season player is independent; no allowance for shared college circumstances.
independent_diagnostic.warnings: Sparse events and few contributing colleges can impair the approximation. Diagnostic thresholds 30 and 10 are cautions, not validity guarantees.

source.population: All eligible player-seasons, restricted to colleges represented by an ever-drafted player in source window.
source.bins: Original within-band rank-based quantile bins; ties follow historical row-order convention.
source.outcome: Ever-drafted label repeated for each included player-season; rates weight player-seasons, not distinct players.
source.dependence: Colleges linked by a shared player IN THIS ANALYSIS BAND are merged into a connected component. All rows from a college stay together across years. Different components are assumed approximately independent.
